svg.title: How vm-tuneup-morpheus-plugin works
svg.desc: Architecture and request flows of vm-tuneup-morpheus-plugin: the browser, the plugin inside the Morpheus appliance, and the HVM VMs it audits.
svg.text: We've migrated to HVM. Now what? An audit of HVM VMs inside Morpheus: what the migration left behind, what to tune next, and a plan to do it.

D. Guest checks (and Check guest agent)
Every gate must pass, in this order:
POST with X-Requested-With, same origin, Morpheus CSRF
Role has Run guest and host checks (Full)

F. Fill in OS fields: the one write
Shown when the VM's Morpheus record has empty OS fields
and the guest checks read the OS inside the guest.
Needs Update VM records (Full), plus the POST checks and
You confirm in a dialog first.
Copies that OS into only the EMPTY fields (OS type,
family, platform, version); never changes a value
Each write is logged with your user id, the VM and the
One and done, read-only except one opt-in write
Install, scan, plan, uninstall. The plugin has no settings and no schedules: scans run only when someone opens a tab or runs the report, and guest and host commands only for
people with the permission (the guest and host checks only on a click). It never changes a VM's hardware, a host or a cluster; its one write fills in empty OS fields, opt-in and
confirmed. Every finding says what happens if you leave it and what fixing it costs (downtime, risk, whether it can be undone, what to do first), and is either a Recommendation
(doable in the Morpheus UI or inside the guest OS) or a Consideration (needs host-level work; never recommended).
